why: Butt & Benjamin §28.9: adónde is OPTIONAL with verbs of motion (¿adónde/dónde van ustedes?); only dónde works without motion. The variant directive said 'not dónde', so its clozes offered Dónde as a distractor that is also correct, and two translations used English 'going to' future ('Where are you going to buy…?') where no motion is involved and dónde is the natural answer.
